after.zh: 缩略图服务每天要处理成千上万张照片：先低通再采样防止混叠，一层层缩小省下计算量。作业 1 比较直接卷积、可分离卷积和 FFT 的速度，比的也是同一笔账。
after.en: A thumbnail service handles thousands of photos a day: low-pass before sampling against aliasing, and shrinking level by level to save work. Assignment 1, comparing the speed of direct convolution, separable convolution and the FFT, does the same accounting.

t.zh: 缩略图服务正式上线：相册要 4×4 的小图标，照片里有斑马板、布纹、细条纹和文字。
t.en: The thumbnail service goes live: the album wants 4×4 icons, and the photos include zone plates, fabric, fine stripes and text.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：从 32×32 缩成 4×4，不出莫尔纹，计算量不超过 19。
t.en: Your task in this level: shrink 32×32 to 4×4 with no moiré and a cost of no more than 19.

brief.zh: 相册要给每张照片做 4×4 的小图标：从 32×32 缩成 4×4，斑马板、布纹、文字都不能出莫尔纹，计算量不能超过 19。
brief.en: The photo album wants a 4×4 icon for every photo: shrink 32×32 to 4×4 with no moiré on zone plates, fabric or text, and a cost of no more than 19.

hint.zh: 前三关各管一件事：先模糊再取样、糊多少、在小图上做事更便宜。
hint.en: Each of the last three levels settled one thing: blur before sampling, how much to blur, and working on small pictures being cheaper.
